item.title: Amid power shortage concerns, the presidential office and government fuel necessity of additional nuclear power plant construction (전력난 지적에 추가 원전 건설 필요성 불지피는 청와대·정부)
item.description:
The presidential office and government are increasingly mentioning the construction of additional nuclear power plants as a solution to ensure stable power supply for the southwestern semiconductor cluster and artificial intelligence (AI) data centers. (청와대와 정부에서 서남권 반도체 클러스터와 인공지능(AI) 데이터센터에 안정적 전력 공급을 위한 방안으로 원자력발전소 추가 건설 언급이 잇따라 나오고 있다.)

Cheong Wa Dae Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom emphasized the state's role in the era of the AI production revolution on Facebook on the 5th, writing, "In the age of AI, the state's role is to build power grids, develop industrial sites, and organize supply chains." He added, "Competitiveness in the AI era lies not in individual companies' competitiveness but in the competitiveness of the entire national production system." On the 2nd, Kim hinted at the possibility of constructing new nuclear power plants and expanding dams, stating, "Let's free up power and water." ( 김용범 청와대 정책실장은 5일 페이스북에 인공지능 생산혁명 시대의 국가의 구실을 강조하며 “인공지능 시대에 국가의 역할은 전력망을 구축하고, 산업부지를 조성하며, 공급망을 조직하는 것”이라고 적었다. 그는 “인공지능 시대의 경쟁력은 개별 기업의 경쟁력이 아니라 국가 전체 생산체계의 경쟁력”이라고 덧붙였다. 김 실장은 지난 2일 “전력과 용수를 풀자”며 신규 원전 건축과 댐 증축 가능성을 시사했다.)

Presidential Economic Growth Senior Secretary Ha Joon-kyung also said on the 4th regarding the mega-project power supply issue, "While it's certain that the renewable energy sector will be activated, for what cannot be fully covered, nuclear power plants may be necessary." Climate, Energy, and Environment Minister Kim Seong-hwan said on the 3rd, "We need to quickly review whether we should build additional nuclear plants. There is land to build two more units at the Hanbit nuclear plant in Yeonggwang, South Jeolla, and two more at the Saeul nuclear plant in Ulju, Ulsan, totaling four units." Earlier, on the 29th of last month, Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik responded to a question about the possibility of introducing additional nuclear plants by saying, "You can think of it as being included in the 12th Basic Plan for Power Supply and Demand (Electricity Plan)." The 12th Electricity Plan includes plans for how electricity will be produced and supplied by 2040. In April, the general committee for establishing the 12th Electricity Plan forecasted that power consumption in 2040 would be 657.6 to 694.1 TWh (terawatt-hours), with peak annual power demand reaching 131.8 to 138.2 GW (gigawatts). However, this forecast is before reflecting the three major mega-projects. <<> In response to the government's moves, climate and environmental groups have begun to push back. The "National Emergency Action to Block New Nuclear Power Plants," an alliance of anti-nuclear and environmental groups, stated, "The 12th Electricity Plan must not become a plan to expand supply to meet the power demand of specific industries and large corporations," and added, "If the government wants its past statements on addressing the climate crisis and energy transition to be credible, it should choose a path toward a society that can operate with less electricity and a safe, just transition to renewable energy." <<> Meanwhile, President Lee Jae-myung rebutted the People Power Party's claim that the announcement of the "three major mega-projects" on the 4th was aimed at boosting approval ratings, saying, "If it had been a political tool for approval rating management, we would have started it before the local elections." <<> Reporters Go Kyung-ju, Park Ki-yong, and Jo Hee-yeon goh@hani.co.kr ( 하준경 청와대 경제성장수석도 지난 4일 메가프로젝트 전력 공급 문제에 관해 “재생에너지 분야가 활성화될 것이 확실하지만 다 커버가 안 되는 것들은 원전이 필요할 수도 있을 것”이라고 말했다. 김성환 기후에너지환경부 장관도 지난 3일 “원전을 추가로 지어야 할지 빨리 검토해야 한다. 전남 영광 한빛 원전에 2기, 울산 울주 새울 원전에 2기 등 총 4기를 더 지을 땅이 있다”고 말했다. 앞서 강훈식 대통령 비서실장 역시 지난달 29일 원전 추가 도입 가능성에 대한 질문에 “12차 전력수급기본계획(전기본)에 내용이 들어갈 것으로 생각하면 된다”고 말한 바 있다. 12차 전기본엔 2040년까지 전력을 어떻게 생산하고 공급할지에 관한 계획이 담긴다. 지난 4월 12차 전기본 수립 총괄위원회는 2040년 전력소비량은 657.6~694.1TWh(테라와트시), 연중 최대 전력 수요는 131.8~138.2GW(기가와트)에 이를 것으로 전망했다. 다만 이 전망은 3대 메가프로젝트가 반영되기 전이다.)

item.title: Board of Audit and Inspection Launches Audit of Election Commission…Focusing on Ballot Paper Budget, Various Allowances, etc. (감사원, 선관위 감사 착수…투표지 예산·각종 수당 등 대상)
item.description:
The Board of Audit and Inspection (BAI) on the 6th began an audit in the accounting sector of the National Election Commission (NEC), which caused a shortage of ballot papers during the June 3 local elections, investigating issues such as the signing of private contracts and suspicions of improper business trips. (감사원이 6·3지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태를 일으킨 선거관리위원회를 대상으로 수의계약 체결과 부정 출장 의혹 등에 대한 회계 분야 감사에 6일 착수했다.)

The BAI announced on the same day, "We will audit the central NEC, as well as the election commissions in Seoul, Gyeonggi, and Busan, along with their respective district, city, and county commissions, regarding the planning and execution of election-related budgets since 2022, as well as matters of significant public concern." (감사원은 이날 “중앙선관위와 서울·경기·부산 지역 선관위 및 관할 구·시·군 선관위를 대상으로 2022년 이후 선거 관련 예산 편성과 집행 실태, 국민적 의혹이 큰 사항 등을 감사할 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

The audit targets consist of 12 items across two areas: △ the process of planning and executing election-related budgets, and △ issues of public concern and compliance with previous BAI corrective orders. (감사 대상은 △선거 관련 예산 편성과 집행 과정 △국민 의혹과 감사원 처분 요구 등 2개 분야 12개 사항이다.)

First, the primary focus of the audit is on the planning and execution of the ballot paper printing budget and the related printing contracts. The audit plans to scrutinize the payment of various allowances, including attendance fees for election duties, document review allowances, management allowances, and incentive payments, as well as the purchase and management of election materials and the leasing of buildings. This comes after it was revealed that former Central NEC Chairperson Noh Tae-ak and other non-standing members received excessive allowances worth tens of millions of won, and that employees who had received false allowances over the past five years received only light disciplinary actions. Additionally, the audit will cover the operation of fair election support teams, the payment of daily wages for temporary workers, the management costs and allowances for overseas election management, and the estimation of election expenses and budget adjustments, including personnel costs. (우선, 투표용지 인쇄 예산 편성과 집행, 인쇄 계약 사항이 주요 감사 대상이다. 선거 업무 관련 출석 수당과 인건검토수당·관리수당·격려금 등 각종 수당 지급 실태와 선거 물품 구매·관리, 건물 임차 상황도 모두 살펴볼 계획이다. 노태악 전 중앙선관위원장 등 비상임 위원들이 억대 수당을 챙기고, 지난 5년 동안 허위 수당을 받은 직원들이 솜방망이 징계를 받은 데 그친 문제 등이 드러난 상황이다. 또, 공정선거지원단 운영과 기간제 근로자 일용임금 집행, 재외국민선거 관리경비와 수당 지급, 인건비 등 선거 경비소요 추계와 예산 조정 관련 사항도 감사 대상이다.)

Regarding public concerns, the issue of the NEC's private contract procurement is also included in the audit. The BAI will examine the process of calculating contract prices, suspicions of funneling work to specific entities, contract splitting, and whether there are special relationships between contract parties and the NEC. It will also look into the overseas business trips and travel expense payments of NEC officials, as well as the execution of operational expenses and overtime meal costs. The management of reimbursement claims for candidates whose elections were invalidated will also be audited. The NEC has failed to recover approximately 23.6 billion won from candidates who must return election expenses due to violations of election law. (국민 의혹과 관련해선, 선관위의 수의계약 체결 문제도 감사 대상에 포함됐다. 계약단가 산정 과정과 일감 몰아주기, 쪼개기 계약 의혹, 계약 당사자와 선관위의 특수관계 여부 등을 모두 살펴본다. 또 선관위 공무원의 국외 출장과 여비 집행, 업무추진비와 특근매식비 집행 실태도 들여다본다. 당선무효자 선거비용 반환채권 관리 실태도 감사 대상이다. 선관위는 선거법 위반 등으로 선거비용을 반환해야 할 후보들에게 약 236억원을 회수하지 못하고 있다.)

However, the BAI stated regarding the ballot paper printing issues, "We will carefully review the timing, scope, and whether to initiate an audit, taking into account the investigations by the joint prosecution and police investigation headquarters and the (National Assembly) parliamentary inquiry." It also plans to check whether previous audit findings from BAI audits, such as the 2022 regular audit of the central NEC, have been properly implemented. (다만 감사원은 투표용지 인쇄 관련 문제는 “검경합동수사본부 수사와 (국회) 국정조사 상황 등을 고려해 감사 착수 여부와 범위, 시기 등을 신중하게 검토해 결정할 예정”이라고 밝혔다. 또, 2022년 중앙선관위 정기감사 등 과거 감사원 감사에서 지적받은 사항을 제대로 이행했는지도 들여다볼 계획이다.)

Before commencing the full-scale audit, the BAI began collecting data for an accounting inspection of the NEC on the 23rd of last month and formed an audit team of 42 members, led by the Director General of the Administrative and Safety Audit Bureau. The audit will be conducted in two phases: July (6th to 24th) and August (1st to 14th). The BAI plans to determine the audit targets, key focus areas, and whether to expand the audit team based on the results of the first-phase audit in July before proceeding with the second phase. (감사원은 본격적인 감사 착수에 앞서 지난달 23일부터 선관위 회계 검사를 위한 자료 수집에 들어갔으며, 행정·안전감사국장을 단장으로 42명의 감사반을 편성했다. 감사는 7월(6∼24일)과 8월(1일∼14일) 두 차례에 걸쳐 진행된다. 감사원은 7월 1단계 감사 결과에 따라 감사 대상과 중점 사항, 감사 인력 확대 여부를 결정해 2단계 감사를 실시한다는 계획이다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.k)

item.title: Lee Byung-tae: "No Reason to Resign" ... Park Ji-won: "Disappear Quickly" (이병태 “사퇴할 이유 없다”…박지원 “빨리 사라지길”)
item.description:
Lee Byung-tae, deputy head of the Presidential Committee on Regulatory Rationalization, who claimed that the May 18 Democratic Uprising had become a "sanctuary" amid calls for severe punishment of the Seoul Baejae High School baseball team for their "mockery cheer" related to the May 18 movement, has dismissed demands for his resignation. (‘5·18 조롱 응원’을 한 서울 배재고 야구부에 대한 중징계를 두고 “5·18이 성역이 됐다”고 주장한 이병태 대통령 직속 규제합리화위원회 부위원장이 자진사퇴 주장을 일축했다.)

In a phone interview with the Chosun Ilbo on the 5th, Lee argued, "I posted that because I thought the severe punishment of Baejae High School was an undesirable aspect of Korea, but it has been distorted by the political actions of politicians." Stating, "This is a statement based on personal conscience, so my stance will not change," Lee responded to calls for resignation within the ruling party by saying, "It's a two-year term, so I’m not sure on what grounds they’re doing this" and "If the appointing authority (the president) wants, I can resign anytime, but I haven’t received any contact." ( 이 부위원장은 5일 조선일보와 전화 인터뷰에서 “배재고 중징계가 한국의 바람직하지 않은 모습이라고 생각해 올린 글이었는데, 이게 정치인들의 정치 행위들로 인해 변질됐다”고 주장했다. “개인의 양심에 따른 발언이기 때문에, 입장이 바뀔 일은 없다”는 이 부위원장은 여권 내 사퇴 요구에 대해 “2년 임기로 돼 있는데 무슨 근거로 그러는지 잘 모르겠다”며 “임명권자(대통령)가 원하면 언제든지 (사퇴)할 수 있겠지만 연락 온 건 없다”고 말했다. )

In an interview with Yonhap News TV on the same day, Lee also said, "I don’t see any reason for me to resign" and "If I were swayed by being shaken, that would be even more foolish." ( 이 부위원장은 같은 날 연합뉴스티브이(TV)와 인터뷰에서도 “내가 사퇴할 이유가 없지 않나”라며 “흔든다고 흔들리면 그게 더 바보 같은 짓”이라고 말했다. )

Under the Framework Act on Administrative Regulations, members of the Regulatory Rationalization Committee cannot be dismissed or removed against their will except in cases such as "being sentenced to imprisonment without labor or heavier" or "being unable to perform duties due to long-term physical or mental decline." This means there is no way to force Lee out except through his voluntary resignation. ( 행정규제기본법에 따라 규제합리화위원회 위원은 ‘금고 이상의 형을 선고받은 경우’나 ‘장기간의 심신쇠약으로 직무를 수행할 수 없게 된 경우’를 제외하고는 본인의 의사와 관계없이 면직되거나 해촉되지 않는다. 이 부위원장의 자진사퇴 말고는 이 부위원장을 물러나게 할 방법이 없는 셈이다. )

Voices within the ruling party continue to demand Lee's resignation. Park Ji-won, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, criticized in a Facebook post on the 6th, "The Baejae students visiting Gwangju Ilgo and paying respects at the May 18 Democratic Cemetery in repentance is respect for basic rights." He added, "Despite Vice Chairman Lee’s talk of basic rights and the Blue House’s stern warning, he insists he hasn’t heard anything from the president, the appointing authority, and remains unbothered." ( 여권 내에서는 이 부위원장의 자진 사퇴를 요구하는 목소리가 계속되고 있다. 박지원 더불어민주당 의원은 6일 페이스북에 올린 글에서 “배재고 학생들이 광주일고를 방문하고 5·18민주묘역을 참배하겠다고 반성하는 것이 기본권의 존중”이라며 “이 부위원장은 기본권 운운하며 청와대의 엄중한 경고에도 임명권자인 대통령으로부터 아무 소리도 듣지 않았다며 아랑곳하지 않고 버티고 있다”고 비판했다. )

He further wrote, "Is intellectual Lee Byung-tae’s basic rights like Chun Doo-hwan’s? I urge him to resign quickly and, if he can’t even return to the soil like Chun, to pay respects and disappear while dedicating himself to Chun Doo-hwan’s unacceptable basic rights." ( 이어 “지식인 이병태씨의 기본권은 전두환식? 빨리 사퇴하고 흙으로도 못 돌아간 전두환을 참배하며, 천하에 용납 못 할 전두환식 기본권을 바치고 사라질 것을 촉구한다”고 덧붙였다. )

Kim Nam-kook, a Democratic Party lawmaker, also argued in a Facebook post on the same day, "Public office is not a place to freely flaunt personal beliefs" and "He should resign immediately." ( 김남국 민주당 의원도 이날 페이스북 글에서 “공직은 개인의 신념을 마음껏 과시하는 자리가 아니”라며 “즉각 자진사퇴해야 한다”고 주장했다. )

Park Beom-kye, a Democratic Party lawmaker, said on MBC Radio’s "Kim Jong-bae’s Focus" on the same day, "I get the feeling that there might be subsequent reactions, responses, or measures from the Blue House," adding, "This will likely be linked to Professor Lee Byung-tae’s future remarks and actions." ( 박범계 민주당 의원은 이날 문화방송(MBC) 라디오 ‘김종배의 시선집중’에서 “(청와대에서) 추후적인 반응과 대응과 조치가 있지 않을까 하는 그런 느낌도 가져본다”며 “(이는) 이병태 교수의 추후 언동도 연관이 있을 것”이라고도 말했다. )

Earlier, on the 2nd, Lee, who holds a rank equivalent to a prime minister, claimed on Facebook regarding the Baejae High School baseball team punished for a "Starbucks cheering song" mocking the May 18 Democratization Movement that "May 18 has become a sanctuary in this land" and called it "a scene from North Korea." After controversy erupted, he deleted the post, but on the 4th, he reiterated his stance on Facebook, saying, "The core of my opinion is ‘freedom of expression.’" Although the Blue House issued a stern warning on the same day, stating, "As a person in a responsible position within a government-affiliated agency, this is inappropriate conduct," Lee posted again on Facebook on the night of the 5th, arguing, "The correct way to respond to unpleasant language is not the legal sword of regulation and punishment" and "In life, we must learn to consider others, but we should also cultivate a resilience not to be hurt by others’ words." ( 앞서 총리급인 이 부위원장은 지난 2일 페이스북에서 5·18민주화운동을 조롱하는 ‘스타벅스 응원가’로 징계를 받은 배재고 야구부와 관련해 “이 땅에 5·18이 성역이 된 것”, “북한의 모습”이라고 주장했다. 논란이 일자 해당 글을 삭제했지만 4일 페이스북에서 “내 의견의 핵심은 ‘표현의 자유’”라며 기존 입장을 고수했다. 이에 청와대가 같은 날 “정부 소속 기관의 책임 있는 위치의 사람으로서 부적절한 처신”이라며 엄중히 경고했지만 이 부위원장은 5일 밤 페이스북에 또 글을 올려 “불쾌한 언어에 대응하는 올바른 방법은 규제와 징계라는 법적 칼날이 아니다”, “살아가면서 타인에 대한 배려도 배워야 하지만 타인의 말에 상처받지 않는 심지도 키워야 한다”고 주장했다. )

By Jeon Gwang-jun, Reporter light@hani.co.kr ( 전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Han Byung-do says of Lee Un-ju 'synthetic porn' damage: "Serious crime... strong legal response" (한병도, 이언주 ‘합성 음란물’ 피해에 “중대 범죄…강력 법적 대응”)
item.description:
Han Byung-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 6th, "The recent distribution of synthetic pornographic material and sexual defamation targeting lawmaker Lee Un-ju is a serious criminal act that destroys a person's dignity," adding, "We will apply a zero-tolerance principle at the central party level and pursue a strong legal response." (한병도 더불어민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 “최근 이언주 의원을 대상으로 자행된 합성 음란물 유포와 성적 모독은 한 인간의 존엄을 말살한 중대한 범죄 행위”라며 “중앙당 차원에서 무관용 원칙을 적용해 강력한 법적 대응에 나서겠다”고 6일 밝혔다.)

At a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly that day, Floor Leader Han defined the incident as "not an exercise of freedom of political expression, but blatant violence and character assassination," and said, "What is even more shocking is the fact that secondary harm is occurring, with people laughing at and mocking the victim's suffering and reposting the material." Han added, "We will root out and severely punish these shameless illegal perpetrators, who can never be tolerated for any reason, to ensure such incidents never recur," and urged, "Investigative authorities should also conduct immediate and rigorous investigations to bring both the original creators and those who distributed and shared the material to justice." <<> Lawmaker Song Young-gil also posted on his Facebook that day, criticizing, "Politicians can be criticized and become targets of satire, but the moment someone is reduced to a sexual object and their personality is destroyed, it is not freedom of expression but a crime." Song stated, "It is free to support anyone within our party, but reducing a person to a target of sexual crime and mockery solely for that reason is violence," and added, "Tolerating digital sexual crimes with the attitude that 'it's okay if it's our side,' turning a blind eye and remaining silent, is not neutrality but complicity that fuels the harm." <<> Earlier, the law firm Oreunhaneul, representing Lee Un-ju, issued consecutive press releases on the 3rd and 4th, announcing that they had "initiated legal action against the suspect who produced and posted synthetic pornographic and defamatory content targeting Lee online," and stated, "Secondary harm is continuing, with some online reposting, sharing, quoting, and spreading the material," vowing to hold all possible civil and criminal legal responsibilities. <<> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (한 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 이 사건을 “정치적 표현의 자유가 아닌 명백한 폭력이자 인격 테러”라고 규정하고, “더 충격적인 것은 피해자의 고통을 비웃고 조롱하며 해당 게시물을 재게시하는 2차 가해까지 펼쳐지고 있다는 사실”이라며 이렇게 밝혔다. 한 원내대표는 “어떤 이유로도 결코 용인될 수 없는 파렴치한 불법 행위자들을 발본색원하고 일벌백계해 다시는 이런 일이 재발하지 않도록 하겠다”며 “수사 당국도 즉각적이고 엄정한 수사를 통해 최초 제작자는 물론이고, 유포·공유자까지 모두 법의 심판대에 세워 달라”고 촉구했다.)

item.title: President Lee on Mega-Projects: "Would Prefer No Obstruction... Are You Statesmen?" (이 대통령 “메가프로젝트, 방해는 안 했으면…공인 맞냐”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 6th called for a "speed drive" in administrative procedures regarding the "three major mega-projects," stating, "It would be good to proactively secure electricity and water supply issues rather than waiting for other procedures to finish." <<>> Speaking at the "Public-Private Joint Review Meeting on Mega-Projects" held at the Presidential Office that day, President Lee said, "The central government should anticipate and proactively resolve potential obstacles so that businesses can focus on investment and field operations." He added, "Administrative procedures are particularly problematic; there must absolutely be no delays in investment execution due to prolonged administrative processes." Previously, the government announced through the "three major mega-projects" plans to invest 896 trillion won in the Honam region for semiconductor clusters, 392 trillion won in the Chungcheong region for AI data center construction, and 312 trillion won in the Yeongnam region for physical AI and other initiatives. <<>> President Lee noted, "I heard that the Yongin general industrial complex was completed relatively quickly, but it took six years from site confirmation to fab groundbreaking. While it might be considered fast by some, in my view, it doesn't seem so. Delays in compensation could take even more time, so I hope we can prevent such issues." He continued, "Environmental impact assessments are necessary, but if the same area is involved, do we really need to do it again? It's important to leverage existing results, and even if conducted anew, the process should be shortened. If it's something that must be done anyway, rather than wasting time on procedures, I suggest pursuing it in parallel or simultaneously as long as it's not illegal." <<>> He also instructed that the processes of negotiated acquisition and compulsory expropriation for land acquisition should begin simultaneously to expedite the timeline. "If there are land-grabbing issues in the acquisition process, negotiations take a lot of time, and compulsory expropriation starts only at the end. I want you to initiate negotiated acquisition and compulsory expropriation at the same time," President Lee said. <<>> Furthermore, President Lee aimed criticism at the opposition party, stating, "We are trying to create new opportunities for our people, especially struggling young people. Even if you can't cooperate, I hope you won't seriously obstruct the efforts." He added, "They argue for balance based on the premise that a project is feasible, then claim it's deception or a stunt based on the premise that it's impossible. Is it proper for public officials in charge of national affairs to take such an attitude? Pick one: either criticize based on the premise of impossibility, or point out imbalance based on the premise of possibility. Just do one." <<>> Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 6일 ‘3대 메가프로젝트’와 관련해 “전력, 용수 문제도 다른 절차가 끝날 때까지 기다릴 게 아니라 선제적으로 확보하면 좋겠다”며 행정절차 ‘속도전’을 주문했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok declares candidacy for Democratic Party leader… Takes aim at Jung Cheong-rae, saying "Self-centered politics causing party confusion" (김민석, 민주당 대표 출마선언…정청래 겨냥 “자기정치로 당 혼선”)
item.description:
Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok announced on the 6th, "I declare my candidacy for the leadership of the Democratic Party with an infinite sense of responsibility for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration." This is the first official declaration among the candidates for the party leader position in the August 17 national convention. (김민석 전 국무총리가 6일 “이재명 정부 국정 성공에 대한 무한한 책임감으로 민주당 대표 출마를 선언한다”고 밝혔다. 8·17 전당대회 당대표 주자 중 첫 공식 출마 선언이다.)

In a statement at Jeonil Building 245 in Dong-gu, Gwangju-Jeonnam Integrated Special City, the former Prime Minister Kim said, "My decision to run for party leader is the product of a heavy sense of responsibility, prepared for intense internal party debate for the party's future. The top priority for the success of the absolute task—the Lee Jae-myung administration—is to achieve innovation within the ruling Democratic Party," declaring his candidacy. (김 전 총리는 이날 전남광주통합특별시 동구 전일빌딩245에서 “저의 당 대표 선거 출마는 당의 미래를 위해 치열한 당내 논쟁 각오한 무거운 책임감 산물이다. 절대 과제인 이재명 정부 성공을 위한 최우선 과제는 집권당인 민주당의 혁신 이뤄내는 것”이라며 당 대표 출마를 선언했다.)

Kim added, "Over the past year, the Democratic Party has failed to translate public support for the president and government into party backing and election results. The harm of self-centered politics over the past year has plunged the party and party-government cooperation into confusion," and warned, "At this rate, it will be difficult to achieve government success, win general elections, or maintain party unity." This is interpreted as a jab at former party leader Jung Cheong-rae. (김 전 총리는 “(민주당은) 지난 1년간 대통령과 정부에 대한 국정 지지를 정당 지지와 선거 결과로 연결하지 못했다. 지난 1년, 자기정치의 폐해가 당과 당정 협력을 혼선에 빠뜨렸다”며 “이대로는 국정 성공도 총선 승리도 당의 단합도 어렵다”고도 했다. 정청래 전 대표를 겨냥한 말로 해석된다.)

Kim also stated, "I am deeply grateful to President Kim Dae-jung, who taught me politics; President Roh Moo-hyun, who opened the door for my return by calling the merger with Jeong Mong-joon's National Unity 21 'a rational and passionate move' ahead of the 2002 presidential election; President Moon Jae-in, who restored the Democratic Party flag I upheld; and President Lee Jae-myung, who has made me a partner in state affairs. I will carry on their spirit and legacy as a party member." (김 전 총리는 “제게 정치를 가르쳐주신 김대중 대통령님, (2002년 대선을 앞두고 정몽준 국민통합21 후보와) ‘단일화는 합리적 충정이었다’라며 복귀의 문을 열어주신 노무현 대통령님, 제가 지킨 민주당 깃발을 복권해주신 문재인 대통령님, 국정의 파트너로 삼아주신 이재명 대통령님, 네 분 모두에게 깊이 감사드리고 당인으로서 그 정신과 역사를 이어가겠다”고도 했다.)

Before his announcement, former Prime Minister Kim visited the May 18th National Cemetery. There, he laid flowers and offered incense at the memorial tower before visiting the graves of activist martyrs Yoon Sang-won and Park Hyun-sook. In the guestbook, he wrote, "Now, May 18th is not just history but the future" and "Kim Min-seok, candidate for Democratic Party leader." (김 전 총리는 출마 선언에 앞서 이날 국립5·18민주묘지를 참배했다. 이 자리에서 김 전 총리는 민주묘지 추모탑에서 헌화·분향한 뒤 윤상원·박현숙 열사 묘소를 찾아 참배했다. 방명록에는 ‘이제 5·18이 역사를 넘어 미래입니다’ ‘민주당 당대표 후보 김민석’이라고 적었다.)

Choi Ha-yan reporter chy@hani.co.kr Jeong Hye-min reporter jhm@hani.co.kr (최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr 정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: DP, Innovation, and Social Democrats in National Assembly's Policy Committee: "We Need to Hold Homeplus Hearings" (국회 정무위서 민주·혁신·사민 “홈플러스 청문회 열어야”)
item.description:
Lawmakers affiliated with the Democratic Party of Korea (DP), the Rebuilding Korea Party (Innovation Party), and the Social Democratic Party, who serve on the National Assembly's Policy Affairs Committee, demanded on the 6th during the first plenary session of the second half of the term that hearings be held regarding Homeplus, which faces bankruptcy following a decision to terminate its corporate rehabilitation procedures. <<> DP lawmaker Min Byeong-deok requested a point of order during the Policy Committee plenary session, stating, "On the 3rd, the Seoul Rehabilitation Court decided to terminate Homeplus's rehabilitation procedures due to the failure of its largest shareholder, MBK Partners, and creditor Meritz Financial to secure 200 billion won in new funds." He added, "I strongly urge the Policy Committee to push for hearings on the Homeplus situation to protect the livelihoods of the 100,000 workers (including Homeplus employees, partners, and suppliers) and their families, and to hold financial authorities strictly accountable for their oversight responsibilities." <<> Min further stated, "MBK, which has recovered over 5 trillion won in cash over the past 10 years through dividends and asset sales, has remained silent on funding for rehabilitation and Chairman Kim Byung-ju's personal guarantees. Meritz Financial, as the largest creditor, has also shirked its social responsibility and engaged in predatory financial practices." He added, "This is a typical livelihood disaster caused by a predatory private equity fund that acquires companies with heavy debt, strips them of value, and then flees." <<> DP lawmaker Park Hong-bae also stated, "A hearing is essential to investigate the process of MBK Partners' acquisition of Homeplus and the various issues that have arisen since." DP lawmaker Lee Kang-il remarked, "If the main opposition party does not cooperate in organizing the committees, it may be difficult to schedule hearings. There is a risk of missing the right time, so for matters related to livelihoods, we should hold hearings even if we have to do it on our own." This suggests that even if the People Power Party does not engage in bipartisan consultation on the seven standing committees where chairpersons have yet to be decided in the second half of the 22nd National Assembly, the DP should lead the effort to hold hearings. <<> Minority opposition lawmakers attending the Policy Committee also demanded hearings. Rebuilding Korea Party lawmaker Lee Hae-min said, "If we combine our numbers here, we have three parties (DP, Innovation Party, Social Democratic Party), so I believe we can hold bipartisan hearings." Social Democratic Party lawmaker Han Chang-min also stated, "I hope our standing committee will actively hold hearings to uncover and hold accountable MBK and Meritz Securities' irresponsibility." <<> DP-affiliated Policy Committee Chair Yoo Dong-soo said during the meeting, "Once the opposition party's Policy Committee secretary is appointed, we will proceed with holding hearings through consultation between the secretaries." On this day, the Policy Committee appointed DP lawmaker Park Sang-hyeok, serving his second term, as the ruling party's Policy Committee secretary. <<> Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당과 조국혁신당, 사회민주당 소속 국회 정무위원회 위원들이 6일 후반기 첫 전체회의에서 기업회생절차 폐지 결정으로 파산 위기에 놓인 홈플러스에 대해 청문회를 열자고 요구했다.)

item.title: Democracy Party: "Lee Jin-sook Sent a Wreath to Baejae High School in an Immature Manner... Students Are the Mature Ones" (민주 “이진숙, 미숙하게 배재고에 화환…학생들이 성숙”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea criticized People Power Party lawmaker Lee Jin-sook for sending a supportive wreath to Seoul's Baejae High School, calling it "highly inappropriate and an act that casts doubt on even the most basic sense of history." (이진숙 국민의힘 의원이 서울 배재고에 응원 화환을 보낸 것을 두고 더불어민주당은 “매우 부적절하며, 최소한의 역사의식마저 의심케 하는 처사”라고 비판했다.)

Democratic Party spokesperson Park Kyung-mi stated in a written briefing on the 6th, "The students apologized in a mature manner, while the lawmaker sent a wreath in an immature way." (박경미 민주당 대변인은 6일 서면브리핑에서 “학생들은 성숙하게 사죄했고 국회의원은 미숙하게 화환을 보냈다”며 이같이 말했다.)

Previously, on the 29th of last month, baseball players from Baejae High School sang a 'Starbucks cheer song' mocking the May 18 Democratic Uprising directed at players from Gwangju Jeil High School during the 81st Blue Dragon National High School Baseball Tournament. On the 1st, they received a heavy disciplinary measure of a 'six-month ban from national tournaments' from the Korea Baseball Softball Association (KBSA). (앞서 배재고 야구부 선수들은 지난달 29일 제81회 청룡기 전국고교야구대회에서 광주제일고(광주일고) 선수들을 향해 5·18민주화운동을 조롱하는 ‘스타벅스 응원가’를 불렀다가 지난 1일 대한야구소프트볼협회(KBSA)로부터 ‘6개월 전국대회 출전 정지’라는 중징계를 받았다.)

Around 80 individuals, including Baejae High School baseball players, coaches, parents, and staff, were scheduled to visit Gwangju Jeil High School to apologize and jointly pay respects at the May 18 Democratic Cemetery on the afternoon of that day. However, a day before on the 5th, a controversy erupted when it was revealed that lawmaker Lee had sent a wreath to Baejae High School bearing the phrases, "What does Starbucks have to do with May 18?" and "We stand with the Baejae High School students." (배재고 야구부 선수들과 지도자, 학부모, 교직원 등 80여명은 이날 오후 광주일고를 사과 방문하고 5·18 민주묘지를 함께 참배할 예정인데 이를 하루 앞둔 5일 이 의원이 “스타벅스가 5·18과 무슨 관계가 있나”, “배재고 학생들과 함께 합니다”라는 글귀가 적힌 화환을 배재고에 보냈다고 밝히면서 논란이 일었다.)

Spokesperson Park assessed, "The inappropriate cheer chant by Baejae High School's baseball team was a mistake that cannot be taken lightly," but added, "Fortunately, the power of education and the spirit of solidarity are still alive." She continued, "I express my respect for the courage of Baejae High School, which acknowledged its wrongdoing and took a responsible stance to apologize, and for the包容 of the Gwangju Jeil High School community, which accepted this with a generous heart." (박 대변인은 “배재고 야구부의 부적절한 응원 구호는 결코 가벼이 넘길 수 없는 과오”라면서도 “다행히 교육의 힘과 연대의 정신은 살아 있었다”고 평가했다. 이어 “잘못을 인정하고 책임 있는 자세로 사죄에 나선 배재고의 용기와, 이를 너른 마음으로 받아들인 광주일고 공동체의 포용에 경의를 표한다”고 덧붙였다.)

However, she expressed strong regret over the lawmaker's act of sending a wreath. Park stated, "Even though an educational resolution process for the Baejae High School incident is proceeding calmly, some within the People Power Party are trying to turn it into a subject of political strife." She criticized, "In particular, the action of a certain lawmaker from the People Power Party to send a supportive wreath to Baejae High School is highly inappropriate and an act that casts doubt on even the most basic sense of history." Park added, "I express strong regret over whether a lawmaker, who has a responsibility to mediate conflicts and heal wounds, might be using the Baejae High School incident as a spark to rally their support base." (반면 이 의원이 화환을 보낸 것을 두고는 강한 유감을 표했다. 박 대변인은 “배재고 사태에 대한 교육적 해결 절차가 차분히 진행 중임에도, 국민의힘 일각에서는 이를 정쟁의 소재로 삼으려 하고 있다”며 “특히 국민의힘의 모 의원이 배재고에 응원 화환을 보낸 행동은 매우 부적절하며, 최소한의 역사의식마저 의심케 하는 처사”라고 비판했다. 박 대변인은 “갈등을 중재하고 상처를 치유해야 할 책임이 있는 국회의원이, 배재고 사태를 지지층 결집의 불씨로 삼고 있는 것은 아닌지 강한 유감을 표한다”고 밝혔다.)

Park further noted, "What a politician representing the people should do is not send a wreath to fan the flames of factional fights, but to observe and provide solid support so that this incident can become a valuable opportunity for students to learn about the noble values of democracy and the attitude of mutual respect." She concluded, "I hope the People Power Party will look at the mature steps of these children with shame and engage in self-reflection." (박 대변인은 “국민을 대표하는 정치인이 해야 할 일은 화환을 보내 진영 싸움을 부추기는 것이 아니라, 이번 사태가 학생들에게 민주주의의 숭고한 가치와 상호 존중의 태도를 배우는 소중한 계기가 될 수 있도록 지켜보고 든든히 지원하는 일”이라며 “국민의힘은 아이들의 성숙한 발걸음을 부끄러운 눈으로 바라보며 자성하기 바란다”고 덧붙였다.)

item.description:

item.title: PPP Wearing Black Masks Calls New ICT Act on 'Punitive Damages' a 'Gag Law' (검은 마스크 쓴 국힘, ‘징벌적 손배’ 새 정보통신망법에 “입틀막법”)
item.description:
On the 6th, a day before the revised Information and Communications Network Act takes effect, the People Power Party (PPP) launched a full-scale offensive, labeling the law an 'Online Gag Law.' (국민의힘이 개정 정보통신망법 시행을 하루 앞둔 6일 해당 법에 대해 ‘온라인 입틀막법’이라고 규정하며 총공세에 나섰다.)

PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk said at a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly that morning, "Starting tomorrow, the revised Information and Communications Network Act, the so-called 'Gag Law,' comes into effect," adding, "(The revised law) is about shutting down not only the existing legacy media but also the mouths of YouTubers, just before the cancellation of a prosecution." Party leadership, including Chairman Jang and the floor leader, attended the Supreme Council meeting wearing black masks to signify their intention to highlight the unfairness of the revised Information and Communications Network Act. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 이날 오전 열린 국회 최고위원회의에서 “내일부터 개정 정보통신망법, 소위 ‘입틀막법’이 시행된다”며 “(개정 정보통신망법은) 공소취소를 앞두고 기존의 레거시 언론은 물론, 유튜버들의 입까지 모두 틀어막겠다는 것”이라고 했다. 장 대표와 원내대표를 비롯한 국민의힘 지도부는 이날 개정 정보통신망법의 부당함을 알리겠다는 의미로 검은색 마스크를 착용한 채 최고위원회의에 참석했다.)

Chairman Jang emphasized, "If you blind the people, cover their ears, and shut their mouths, the end result is the completion of Lee Jae-myung's dictatorship," and "It reminds me of Hong Kong, where anti-China media closed their doors and were sent to prison. The PPP will revise the Information and Communications Network Act again to protect the people's freedom." (장 대표는 “국민의 눈을 가리고 귀를 막고 입까지 틀어막으면 끝은 바로 이재명 독재의 완성”이라며 “반중 언론의 문을 닫고 감옥에 보낸 홍콩의 모습이 떠오른다. 국민의힘은 정보통신망법을 다시 개정해 국민의 자유를 지킬 것”이라고 강조했다.)

Floor leader Jeong also stated, "The online gag law forces large-scale online platform operators to delete, block, and prevent the distribution of such information," adding, "Platforms will carry out prior censorship, keeping an eye on the authorities, and users will be trapped in self-censorship out of fear of lawsuits and complaints." He urged the Democratic Party, "Suspend the enforcement immediately and begin discussions to revise the act to remove its toxic clauses." (정 원내대표도 “온라인 입틀막법은 대규모 온라인 플랫폼 사업자에 해당 정보의 삭제, 차단 및 유통 방지 업무를 강제한다”며 “플랫폼은 권력의 눈치를 보면서 사전 검열을 할 것이고 이용자는 고소·고발이 두려워 자기 검열에 갇히게 될 것”이라고 말했다. 민주당을 향해 “시행을 즉시 유예하고 독소 조항 삭제를 위한 재개정 논의에 착수하자”고 했다.)

Shin Dong-wook, a Supreme Council member and former journalist, also claimed, "Today is the last day of guaranteed press freedom in South Korea," arguing, "It's about shutting down criticism from YouTubers, online dissent, and opposition party critiques against President Lee Jae-myung." He added, "They plan to have an agency under the Broadcasting Media and Communications Commission judge fake news," further stating, "Delegating judgment to a government-controlled body is itself unconstitutional and a serious setback for democracy." (언론인 출신인 신동욱 최고위원도 “오늘은 대한민국 언론 자유가 보장되는 마지막 날”이라면서 “이재명 대통령에 대한 유튜버들과 온라인상의 비판, 국민적 저항, 야당의 비판을 틀어막겠다는 것”이라고 주장했다. 이어 “가짜뉴스 판단을 방송미디어통신위원회 산하 기구에서 하겠다는 것”이라며 “정부가 통제할 수 있는 기관에 판단을 맡긴다는 것 자체로 이미 위헌이고 민주주의의 심각한 후퇴”라고 덧붙였다.)

In response to the PPP's offensive, the Democratic Party countered, calling it "distortion." Democratic Party spokesperson Park Kyung-mi emphasized to the PPP, "For those of us who have witnessed a reality where lives are lost for the sake of cyber wreckers' view counts, what we need now is not the freedom of manipulation forces, but the safety of the people," stressing that the revised Information and Communications Network Act is a law to prevent harm from false and manipulated information. (국민의힘의 공세에 더불어민주당은 “왜곡”이라고 반박했다. 박경미 민주당 대변인은 국민의힘을 향해 “사이버 렉카의 조회수 장사에 목숨까지 잃는 현실을 지켜본 우리에게 지금 필요한 것은 조작 세력의 자유가 아니라 국민의 안전이다”며 개정 정보통신망법이 허위조작정보의 피해를 막는 법이라고 강조했다.)

Starting on the 7th, under the revised Information and Communications Network Act, punitive damages of up to five times the amount of harm will be imposed for the intentional distribution of false and manipulated information online. False and manipulated information will be judged by 'fact-checking organizations' supported by the Transparency Center, which is under the Broadcasting Media and Communications Commission. (개정 정보통신망법에 따라 7일부터 온라인상 허위조작정보를 고의로 유통할 경우 손해액의 최대 5배까지 징벌적 손해배상이 부과된다. 허위조작정보는 방송미디어통신위원회 산하 투명성센터의 지원을 받는 ‘사실확인단체’가 판단한다.)

Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr 조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party Rejects 'Third-Party Recommendation' for Election Commission Special Investigation, Demanding 'Opposition Recommendation' and 'Unlimited Scope' (국힘, 선관위 특검 ‘제3자 추천안’ 거부…“야당 추천·수사 범위 무제한”)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) on the 6th rejected the Democratic Party's proposal for a special investigation into the National Election Commission (NEC) through a 'third-party recommendation' method, reiterating its demand for an 'opposition recommendation' approach. PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk said at a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly that day, "The special investigation the people want is one with opposition recommendation and an unlimited scope of investigation," adding, "Only then can the people trust the investigation results. Immediately accept a proper people's special investigation." He continued, "(The Democratic Party) says it will limit the scope of the investigation to the current situation and within the NEC," and noted, "It has even been revealed that on election day, Democratic Party lawmaker Seo Young-gyo and former NEC chair Noh Tae-ak had a phone call. To uncover all the truth from the past and uproot the election cartel, limiting the scope of the investigation is simply absurd." He further stated, "If they hold out with a 'bed special investigation,' it will only speed up the collapse of the regime." <<> Floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik also said, "The targets of the special investigation must inevitably include not only the NEC but also the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, which oversees election support tasks. The primary target of the special investigation will be acting NEC Chair Wi Cheol-hwan, the 'president's rice friend,'" adding, "Under the principle of excluding interested parties, the Democratic Party's right to recommend should naturally be excluded." He further argued, "The Democratic Party suddenly brought up a third-party recommendation from the Korean Bar Association, but since the acting chair is a former head of the Korean Bar Association, this too is unacceptable," and dismissed, "Given that Supreme Court justice Noh Tae-ak concurrently served as NEC chair and that incumbent judges also simultaneously serve as chairs of city, provincial, and district election commissions, the Supreme Court recommendation method is also not worth considering." <<> Earlier, on the previous day, Democratic Party acting leader and floor leader Han Byung-do stated on Facebook, "The People Power Party is spouting sophistry that the Democratic Party should be excluded from the process of recommending the NEC special investigation. A third-party recommendation method for appointing the special investigation would be more realistic and fair." The Democratic Party plans to submit the NEC special investigation bill this week. <<> Reporter Kim Hae-jung: sea@hani.co.kr (국민의힘이 6일 더불어민주당의 ‘제3자 추천' 방식 선거관리위원회(선관위) 특검 제안을 거부하며 ‘야당 추천’ 방식을 거듭 요구했다. 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 “국민이 바라는 특검은 야당 추천, 수사 범위 무제한”이라며 “그래야 국민이 수사 결과를 믿을 수 있다. 즉각 제대로 된 국민 특검을 수용하라”고 말했다. 이어 “(민주당은) 수사 범위도 이번 사태와 선관위 내부로 제한하겠다고 한다”며 “선거 당일 서영교 민주당 의원과 노태악 전 중앙선거관리위원장이 통화한 사실까지 드러났는데, 과거로부터의 모든 진상을 규명하고 선거 카르텔까지 뿌리 뽑으려면 수사 범위 제한이야말로 어불성설”이라고 말했다. 그러면서 “‘침대 특검’으로 버틴다면 결국 정권 몰락의 속도만 높아질 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: [Breaking] Blue House recommends resignation of Lee Byung-tae, who called May 18 "sacrosanct"... "Matter is very serious" ([속보] 청와대, “5·18 성역” 이병태 사퇴 권고…“사안 매우 엄중”)
item.description:
On the 6th, the Blue House recommended that Lee Byung-tae, vice chairman of the Regulatory Reform Committee under the direct control of the president, who claimed that "May 18 has become a sacrosanct area," resign. (청와대가 6일 “5·18이 성역이 됐다”고 주장한 이병태 대통령 직속 규제합리화위원회 부위원장에게 사퇴를 권고했다.)

The Blue House issued a statement that afternoon, saying, "The Blue House emphasized and implemented a warning measure, stressing that as a key member appointed to a presidential committee with significant responsibilities and authority, one must strive to align with the government's policy direction." It added, "Subsequently, due to the matter being very serious, we recommended the resignation of Vice Chairman Lee." The Blue House further stated, "Accordingly, Vice Chairman Lee is currently determining his own position," and added, "The Lee Jae-myung administration will continue its efforts to expand inclusivity beyond the divide between conservatives and progressives." item.title: Democratic Party: "No Plans to Handle Prosecution's Supplementary Investigation Rights After Party Convention" (민주 “검찰 보완수사권, 전당대회 이후 처리할 계획은 없어”)
item.description:
Kim Han-gyu, Deputy Chief of the Policy Coordination Office for the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 6th regarding the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights, "There are significant differences within the party, so it is not a situation where we need to resume debate," and added, "There are no plans to handle it after the (August 17) party convention." (김한규 더불어민주당 원내정책수석부대표가 6일 검찰의 보완수사권 폐지 여부와 관련해 “당내 이견이 커서 논쟁을 다시 해야 할 상황은 아니다”라며 “(8·17) 전당대회 이후 처리할 계획은 없다”고 밝혔다.)

Meeting with reporters at the National Assembly on the same day, Deputy Chief Kim said about the direction of amending the Criminal Procedure Act, which includes whether to abolish the supplementary investigation rights for prosecutors belonging to the Prosecution Service set to launch in October, "We have no intention of keeping it in mind for the party convention and letting the next leader decide it later for political reasons. It seems better to handle it before that." ( 김 수석부대표는 이날 국회에서 기자들을 만나, 오는 10월 출범할 공소청 소속 검사의 보완수사권 폐지 여부를 담은 형사소송법 개정 방향에 대해 “전당대회를 염두에 두고 정무적으로 그 후에 다음 대표가 결정하게 할 생각은 전혀 없다. 그 전에 처리하는 게 나을 것 같다”며 이렇게 말했다.)

Deputy Chief Kim stated, "Many party members, supporters, and lawmakers are of the position that supplementary investigation rights should be abolished. We have already clearly stated party policy on abolishing supplementary investigation rights." He added, "There are still some who argue that exceptional supplementary investigation rights are necessary, but that is a minority." He continued, "Discussions are focused on how to prepare good supplementary measures for concerns that may arise (if supplementary investigation rights are abolished), not on whether to abolish them now or not." ( 김 수석부대표는 “당원·지지자·의원들 상당수는 보완수사권을 폐지해야 한다는 입장이다. 이미 당론으로 보완수사권 폐지를 명확히 얘기한 적이 있다”며 “그 이후 여전히 예외적 보완수사권이 필요하다고 주장하는 분들이 있긴 하지만 일부분”이라고 했다. 이어 “(보완수사권 폐지 시) 발생할 수 있는 우려에 대해 어떻게 보완책을 잘 마련할 것인가에 대해 논의가 집중되고 있지, 폐지를 지금 하느냐 마냐를 논의할 사안은 아니다”라고 했다.)

The Democratic Party plans to initiate a revision to the Criminal Procedure Act that includes the direction of abolishing supplementary investigation rights through a 'Criminal Procedure Act Revision Task Force (TF)' formed around the party's parliamentary leadership (Deputy Chief Kim), the policy committee (Deputy Speaker for Social Affairs Park Sang-hyuk), the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee (Secretary Kim Seung-won), and the Public Administration and Security Committee (Secretary Lee Hae-sik). After the proposal, it will undergo review by the Legislation and Judiciary Committee along with other previously proposed amendments. Earlier, Seo Young-gyo, the chairperson of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee from the Democratic Party, announced that she would table the amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act this week and begin review by a subcommittee. ( 민주당은 당 원내지도부(김 수석부대표)와 정책위(박상혁 사회수석부의장), 국회 법제사법위원회(김승원 간사)와 행정안전위원회(이해식 간사)를 중심으로 꾸려진 ‘형사소송법 개정 태스크포스(TF)’에서 보완수사권 폐지 방향을 담은 형사소송법 개정안을 발의한 뒤, 기존 발의된 다른 개정안들과 함께 법사위 심사를 거치도록 할 예정이다. 앞서 민주당 소속의 서영교 법사위원장은 이번 주 안으로 형사소송법 개정안을 상정해 소위원회 심사를 시작하겠다고 밝혔다. )

item.title: President Lee: "Our region was left out, it's impossible... I hope you will not interfere like this" (이 대통령 “우리 지역 빠졌다, 불가능하다…이런 방해 않으셨으면”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 6th directly criticized the conservative opposition for opposing the "Three Major Mega Projects," saying, "Is this really the proper attitude for public officials in charge of national affairs?" (이재명 대통령이 6일 ‘3대 메가프로젝트’를 비판하는 보수 야권을 향해 “나라 살림을 맡은 공인들이 과연 이런 태도를 취하는 게 맞느냐”고 직격했다.)

During his opening remarks at a public-private joint review meeting on the mega projects held at the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae that day, President Lee stated, "Some people, assuming the projects are feasible, first protest by saying, 'Why is our region left out?' but then with the same mouth claim it's a 'scam' or 'impossible.' This is incomprehensible." He added, "I wish they would either criticize based on the premise that the projects are impossible, or point out the imbalance assuming they are possible—just pick one." He continued, "I hope they will not interfere like this," and reiterated, "We are trying to create new opportunities for the Republic of Korea, its people, and struggling youth—please at least refrain from major obstruction, even if you can't fully cooperate." <<> President Lee's remarks are seen as targeting the conservative opposition's criticism—following the announcement of the mega projects on the 29th of last month—that the plan amounts to "catering to specific regions" and lacks "feasibility." The People Power Party (PPP) has argued, regarding the core of the projects, the creation of a semiconductor cluster in the Honam region, that "the government is giving the 'core kernel' of a semiconductor fab to Honam while tossing minor 'sesame seed' tasks to regions like Yeongnam and Chungcheong to pretend this is 'coexistence and balanced development'" (Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon). They have also called for "an immediate halt to the behavior of misleading public opinion with a hollow fireworks show called a mega project with no substance" (Senior Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon). <<> The PPP immediately pushed back. Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk posted on Facebook that day, saying, "Regarding former President Yoon Seok-yeol's 'Great Whale' project, Lee Jae-myung called it 'a project likely to fail nine times out of ten.' Now he says not to criticize his so-called 'mega project'? He says we can't call it impossible—but was it okay to call the Great Whale project 'nine times out of ten a failure'?" <<> The PPP also took a sharp stance the previous day when the Democratic Party, the government, and Cheong Wa Dae announced plans to create a "Future Response Fund," using additional tax revenue from the semiconductor industry boom as investment resources for future generations. Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon stated in a commentary that day, "The essence is nothing more than a 'Power Response Fund' or 'Election Response Fund' aimed at the next party leadership race and general election," and called it "a declaration to use national finances like the regime's pocket money, forcibly pushing a semiconductor cluster into the Honam region, which lacks both power and water." <<> By Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr and Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 메가프로젝트 민관합동 점검회의 머리발언에서 “일부에서는 (프로젝트의 실현이) 가능하다는 것을 전제로 ‘왜 우리 지역은 빠졌나’라고 항의를 하더니 같은 입으로 ‘사기다’, ‘불가능한 일’이라고 주장을 한다. 이해가 안 된다”며 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 “(메가프로젝트가) 불가능하다는 것을 전제로 비난을 하든지, 가능하다는 전제로 불균형을 지적하든지 둘 중 하나만 하면 좋겠다”라며 “이런 식으로 방해하지 않으셨으면 좋겠다”고 했다. 이어 “대한민국, 국민들, 또 어려운 청년들에게 새로운 기회를 만들려고 하는데 최대한 협조는 못 하더라도 크게 방해는 안 했으면 좋겠다”고 거듭 말했다.)

item.title: Ministry of National Defense Suddenly Postpones Announcement of Plan for 'Integrated Army, Navy, Air Force' National Military Academy (국방부, ‘육·해·공 통합’ 국군사관학교 계획 발표 돌연 연기)
item.description:
The Ministry of National Defense on the 6th abruptly postponed the announcement of the basic plan to establish a unified National Military Academy integrating the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies. (국방부가 6일 육·해·공군 사관학교를 통합한 국군사관학교 창설 기본계획을 발표하려다 갑자기 연기했다.)

The ministry had originally scheduled Minister Ahn Gyu-baek to announce the basic plan for the National Military Academy at 10:30 a.m. that day at the ministry building in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, but notified reporters around 9 a.m. of a "postponement." (국방부는 애초 이날 오전 10시30분 서울 용산구 국방부 청사에서 안규백 장관이 국군사관학교 창설 기본계획을 발표할 예정이었으나, 이날 오전 9시께 “순연”을 출입기자들에게 공지했다.)

According to the ministry, the postponement was inevitable because Minister Ahn had to attend a public-private joint review meeting for mega-projects held at the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae that morning. It is known that Cheong Wa Dae requested Minister Ahn's attendance at the review meeting. (안 장관이 이날 오전 청와대에서 열리는 메가프로젝트 민관합동 점검회의에 참석하게 되면서 연기할 수밖에 없게 됐다는 게 국방부 설명이다. 청와대가 안 장관의 점검회의 참석을 요청한 것으로 알려졌다.)

Earlier, at around 4 p.m. on the 5th, the ministry had notified the press corps covering it of a "briefing on the basic plan for the National Military Academy's establishment at 10:30 a.m. on the 6th." (앞서 국방부는 지난 5일 오후 4시께 ‘6일 오전 10시30분 국군사관학교 창설 기본계획 브리핑을 한다’고 국방부 출입기자단에게 공지했다.)

Within the ministry, there is talk that the cancellation of the briefing stemmed from concerns about provoking opposition to the integration. The alumni associations of the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies plan to hold a mass rally against the merger in front of the National Assembly on the 8th. (이날 브리핑 취소를 두고 통합 반대 쪽을 자극할 것을 우려했다는 이야기도 국방부 내부에서 나온다. 육·해·공군사관학교 총동창회는 오는 8일 국회 앞에서 사관학교 통합 반대 총궐기대회를 개최할 예정이다.)

It is reported that after Minister Ahn accompanies President Lee Jae-myung, who is attending the NATO summit in Ankara, Turkey, on the 7th and 8th, the ministry plans to reschedule the briefing on the National Military Academy's establishment. (국방부는 안 장관이 7~8일 튀르키예 앙카라에서 열리는 북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 정상회의에 참석하는 이재명 대통령을 수행한 이후 국군사관학교 창설 브리핑 일정을 다시 잡을 계획인 것으로 전해졌다.)

The ministry is pursuing the creation of a National Military Academy to strengthen the joint operational capability of the forces, suitable for modern warfare, by integrating the selection of cadets for the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies. The plan involves providing common education for first and second-year students and allowing third and fourth-year students to choose a service branch for specialized education. (국방부는 현대전에 맞는 군의 합동성 강화 등을 위해 국군사관학교를 창설해 육·해·공군 사관학교 생도들을 통합 선발하는 방안을 추진 중이다. 1·2학년엔 함께 공통 교육을, 3·4학년엔 군을 선택해 군별 특화 전공교육을 받도록 한다는 구상이다.)

The ministry commissioned the Korea Institute for Defense Analyses (KIDA) with a research project on reorganizing the military academies but has not disclosed the results. Ministry spokesperson Jeong Bit-na said at a regular briefing that day, "We will announce the basic plan for the National Military Academy soon and hold public hearings and policy briefings. At that time, we plan to release various details, including the research results, and gather opinions." (국방부는 한국국방연구원(KIDA)에 사관학교 개편 연구용역을 맡겼지만 결과를 공개하지 않고 있다. 정빛나 국방부 대변인은 이날 정례브리핑에서 “조만간 국군사관학교 창설 기본계획을 발표하고, 공청회와 정책설명회를 추진할 것”이라며 “이때 연구용역 결과를 포함해 다양한 내용을 공개하고 의견을 수렴할 예정”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Kwon Hyeok-cheol nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Gwangju Military Airport Relocation Gains Momentum... Persuading Muan Residents is Key (광주 군공항 이전 속도전…무안 주민 설득이 관건)
item.description:
As the government decided on the 6th to create a Honam region semiconductor industrial complex on the site of Gwangju's military airport, the schedule for the semiconductor complex development has become intertwined with the speed of the military airport relocation. (정부가 6일 광주 군 공항 터에 호남권 반도체 산업단지를 조성하기로 하면서 반도체 산단 조성 일정이 군 공항 이전 속도와 맞물리게 됐다.)

The Ministry of National Defense designated the Mangun-myeon area in Muan County, part of the South Jeolla-Gwangju Unified Special City, as the preliminary candidate site for the military airport relocation on April 2nd. Following this, the government will prepare and announce support plans for the Muan region, and the relocation site will be finalized after a resident vote. (국방부는 지난 4월2일 전남광주통합특별시 무안군 망운면 일대를 군 공항 예비이전후보지로 선정했다. 이후 정부가 무안 지역 지원계획을 마련해 공고하고 주민투표를 거쳐 이전 부지가 최종 확정된다.)

Whether the Muan county residents agree is a key variable that will determine the pace of the Gwangju military airport relocation project. Muan County has set three major conditions as prerequisites for discussing the military airport relocation: △ First, the relocation of Gwangju's civilian airport to Muan International Airport △ A support package of 1 trillion won from the South Jeolla-Gwangju Special City and the government △ Provision of groundbreaking incentives at the national level. (무안군민의 동의 여부가 광주 군 공항 이전 사업 추진 속도를 좌우할 핵심 변수다. 무안군은 군 공항 이전을 논의하기 위한 전제 조건으로 △광주 민간공항의 무안국제공항 먼저 이전 △전남광주특별시와 정부의 1조원 규모 지원 △국가 차원의 획기적 인센티브 제공 등의 3대 조건을 내걸고 있다.)

Additionally, to meet the investment schedule for the semiconductor complex, the current method of pursuing the military airport relocation project must be reorganized. The current approach is a "donation-in-kind" method, where the project implementer, South Jeolla-Gwangju Unified Special City, first builds the new airport and donates it to the Ministry of National Defense, then receives the existing military airport site in return. This involves a single relocation after all facilities are completed. With this method, it is difficult to predict the exact timing of the military airport relocation. (또 반도체 산단 투자 일정에 맞추려면 현행 군 공항 이전 사업 추진 방식을 개편해야 한다. 현재 방식은 사업시행자인 전남광주통합특별시가 새 공항을 먼저 건설해 국방부에 기부한 뒤 기존 군 공항 부지를 넘겨받는 ‘기부 대 양여’ 방식이다. 모든 시설을 완공한 뒤 일괄 이전 방식으로 이뤄진다. 이 방식으로는 정확한 군 공항 이전 시기를 예측하기 힘들다.)

In this regard, Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik said at a briefing at the presidential office that day, "We will also review various methods to vacate the Gwangju military airport," adding, "Discussions were based on the premise of moving it at an early stage without creating a security vacuum." The Gwangju military airport houses the Air Force's 1st Fighter Wing, which trains pilots using T-50 advanced trainers. There is a possibility that the wing's functions could be dispersed and relocated to military airports nationwide. (이와 관련해 강훈식 대통령비서실장은 이날 청와대 브리핑에서 “광주 군 공항을 비울 수 있는 방법도 다각적으로 검토할 것”이라며 “안보 공백이 발생하지 않는 범위에서 조기에 옮기겠다는 것을 전제로 논의한 것”이라고 말했다. 광주 군 공항에는 티(T)-50 고등훈련기로 조종사를 훈련시키는 공군 제1전투비행단이 자리잡고 있다. 이 비행단의 기능을 전국 군 공항에 분산 재배치할 가능성이 있다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok enters the race with "party-government unity" message… Takes aim at Jeong Cheong-rae, saying "self-serving politics caused party confusion" (김민석 “당정일치” 등판…정청래 겨냥 “자기 정치로 당 혼선”)
item.description:
Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok declared his candidacy for the Democratic Party of Korea's party convention on the 6th, directly targeting former leader Jeong Cheong-rae, stating that "over the past year, the harm of self-serving politics has thrown the party and party-government cooperation into confusion." With Kim's declaration, the race for party leadership is set to intensify, while another candidate, Rep. Song Young-gil, will announce his candidacy on the 8th. (김민석 전 국무총리가 6일 더불어민주당 전당대회 출마를 선언하고 “지난 1년, 자기 정치의 폐해가 당과 당정 협력을 혼선에 빠뜨렸다”며 정청래 전 대표를 직격했다. 이날 김 전 총리의 출마 선언으로 민주당 당권 레이스가 본격화한 가운데 또 다른 당권 주자인 송영길 의원은 오는 8일 출마 선언을 한다.)

At a press conference held at Jeonil Building 245 in Dong-gu, Gwangju, the proposed Gwangju-Jeonnam Special Metropolitan City, Kim emphasized that "at this rate, national affairs cannot succeed, the (2028) general election cannot be won, and party unity is impossible," highlighting himself as a candidate for "party-government unity" to reform the Democratic Party. Reflecting on the recent discord between the party and the presidential office amid a heated convention atmosphere, he appealed to party members and supporters, saying, "With urgent tension and strict rigor, I ask you to decide to replace the party leader." He stressed, "At this historic moment, the party must not become a source of burden or conflict in national affairs." He also criticized former leader Jeong Cheong-rae's tenure, citing issues like the push for a merger with the Jo Kuk Innovation Party, discussions on prosecution reform, candidate nominations, and election strategies, pointing out, "Lack of deliberation, insufficient debate, procedural flaws, and inconsistency have created many problems." (김 전 총리는 이날 전남광주통합특별시 동구 전일빌딩245에서 기자회견을 열어 “이대로는 국정 성공도, (2028년) 총선 승리도, 당의 단합도 어렵다”며 자신이 민주당 혁신을 위한 ‘당정 일치’ 후보임을 부각했다. 그는 최근 전당대회 과열 국면에서 연일 불협화음이 나오던 당-청 관계를 고려한 듯 “절박한 긴장감과 매서운 엄격함으로 당대표 교체의 결단을 내려주실 것을 당원과 지지자 여러분께 호소드린다”며 “역사적 시점에 당이 국정의 짐이나 갈등의 진원이 되어서는 안 된다”고 강조했다. 정 전 대표 체제에서 벌어진 조국혁신당과의 합당 추진, 검찰개혁 논의, 공천과 선거 전략 등을 조목조목 거론하면서는 “숙의 부족, 토론 부족, 절차 미비, 일관성 부족은 많은 문제를 낳았다”고 비판하기도 했다.)

In his statement, Kim emphasized "unlimited responsibility for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration" and highlighted that "only perfect party-government unity and a practical, inclusive, public-centered line is a proven winning path from four Democratic governments." He stated, "We must restore the competent, strong, and winning Democratic Party from the days of Representative Lee Jae-myung," adding, "I have worked most closely with the President for years, aligning our efforts," and "we have deeply shared the direction of national affairs." Initially, Kim planned to announce his candidacy at Gwangju Air Base, designated as a semiconductor production base for the Honam region, but due to forecasted heavy rain, he moved to Jeonil Building 245, which bears 245 suspected bullet marks from the helicopter firing by martial law troops during the May 18 Democratic Uprising. His choice of Gwangju-Jeonnam for the announcement appears to be based on the calculation that the Honam region, home to one-third of the party's dues-paying members, is a key battleground in the convention. He paid respects at the May 18 Democratic Cemetery and wrote in the guestbook, "Now, May 18 transcends history and becomes the future." (김 전 총리는 회견문을 통해 “이재명 정부 국정 성공에 대한 무한한 책임감”을 강조하며 “완벽한 당정 일치와 민생 실용 통합 노선만이 네번의 민주 정부에서 검증된 필승 노선”이라고 부각했다. 그는 “이재명 대표 시절의 유능한 민주당, 강한 민주당, 이기는 민주당을 복원해야 한다”며 “몇 년간 대통령님과 가장 가까이에서 일의 합을 맞춰왔다”, “국정 방향을 깊이 교감해왔다”고 표현했다. 애초 김 전 총리는 호남 반도체 생산기지로 결정된 광주 군 공항에서 출마 선언을 하려 했으나 폭우가 예보되자 5·18 민주화운동 당시 계엄군의 헬기 사격 추정 탄흔 245개가 남아 있는 전일빌딩245로 장소를 옮겼다. 출마 선언지로 전남광주를 택한 것은 권리당원 3분의 1이 모인 호남 당심이 전당대회 승부처란 판단에 따른 것으로 보인다. 그는 국립 5·18 민주묘지에 참배하며 방명록에 ‘이제 5·18이 역사를 넘어 미래입니다’라고 적었다.)

Jeong responded indirectly to Kim on Facebook, saying, "I will only use the language of unity and comradeship." (정 전 대표는 이날 페이스북을 통해 “저는 단결의 언어, 동지의 언어만 쓰겠다”며 김 전 총리를 에둘러 비판했다.)

After attending a meeting of Gyeonggi Provincial Council members in Suwon, Gyeonggi Province, Jeong also shared a photo of himself having a chat with Gyeonggi Governor Choo Mi-ae. This appears intended to highlight his relationship with Governor Choo, who shares a hardline reform stance on issues like prosecution reform. Lawmakers close to Jeong also fired crossfire at Kim. Rep. Han Min-soo criticized, "It's disappointing to see you list anachronistic and out-of-touch remarks from the very first step of your campaign." Rep. Lee Seong-yoon remarked, "It's deplorable to see a declaration that only blames others." Rep. Choi Min-hee pointed out Kim's past departure from the party during the 2002 presidential candidate unification talks, saying, "He left the party 'for candidate unification with Jeong Mong-joon.'" Jeong is expected to formalize his candidacy as early as this week. (이날 경기도 수원에서 열린 경기도의회 의원총회에 참석한 뒤 추미애 경기지사와 차담을 하는 사진을 공개하기도 했다. 검찰개혁 등 강경 개혁 노선을 공유한 추 지사와의 관계를 부각하려는 의도로 보인다. 친정청래계 의원들도 김 전 총리를 향해 십자포화를 퍼부었다. 한민수 의원은 “출마의 첫 자리에서부터 시대착오적이고 유체이탈식 발언을 나열하시는 모습에 실망을 금할 수 없다”고 비판했고, 이성윤 의원은 “남 탓만 하고 비난하는 식의 출마 선언이 개탄스럽다”고 꼬집었다. 최민희 의원은 2002년 대선 후보단일화협의회가 가동되던 때 김 전 총리의 탈당 이력을 두고 “‘정몽준으로의 후보 단일화를 위해’ 탈당한 것”이라고 지적했다. 정 전 대표는 이르면 이번주 출마를 공식화할 것으로 전망된다.)

Rep. Song Young-gil will announce his candidacy in Seoul on the 8th. On the 9th, he is considering visiting the May 18 Democratic Cemetery in Gwangju. At a National Assembly Defense Committee meeting, Song was captured by the media holding his "candidacy declaration." Regarding his campaign message, Song said, "It's all about 2030. Without 2030, there is no presidential election in 2030." (송영길 의원은 8일 서울에서 당대표 출마 선언을 한다. 9일엔 광주 5·18 민주묘지를 참배하는 일정을 검토하고 있다. 이날 국회 국방위원회 전체회의에선 송 의원이 자신의 ‘출마 선언문’을 들고 있는 모습이 언론에 포착됐다. 송 의원은 출마 메시지와 관련해 “오로지 2030이다. 2030 없이는 2030년 대선은 없다”고 했다.)

Gwangju-Jeonnam/Text by Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr and Ko Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr (전남광주/정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Hong Ik-pyo: "Homeplus' Risks Exposed by Deregulation of Private Equity Funds During Lee Myung-bak Era" (홍익표 “홈플러스, MB 시절 사모펀드 규제 완화로 위험성 노출”)
item.description:
<<>> Hong Ik-pyo, senior presidential secretary for political affairs, pointed to "the unethical M&A methods of MBK Partners (the largest shareholder)" regarding Homeplus, which faces bankruptcy after the court's decision to terminate its corporate rehabilitation procedure, and stated he would "try to provide the maximum support possible within the legal framework." ()

In an interview with the presidential office's new media pool released on YouTube on the 6th, Secretary Hong said, "During the Lee Myung-bak administration, deregulation of private equity funds exposed risks, and the damage has been confirmed this time." He attributed the current crisis to the mismanagement by private equity fund MBK, which focused solely on recovering acquisition funds. Earlier, on the 3rd, the Seoul Bankruptcy Court decided to terminate Homeplus' rehabilitation procedure. The decision will be finalized if the company fails to secure 200 billion won in funding within 14 days. ( 홍익표 청와대 정무수석이 법원의 기업회생절차 폐지 결정으로 파산 위기에 놓인 홈플러스에 관해 “(최대주주인) 엠비케이(MBK) 파트너스의 부도덕한 인수·합병(M&A) 방식”을 지적하며 “법적 틀 내에서 할 수 있는 최대한의 지원을 하려고 노력”하겠다고 말했다.)

Secretary Hong added, "The Homeplus incident is the most symbolic example of the side effects when M&A goes wrong. Particularly, given the potential for massive unemployment and widespread damage to partner companies, financial authorities should actively seek improvements to related systems to prevent such recurrences in the future." ( 홍 수석은 6일 유튜브를 통해 공개된 청와대 뉴미디어풀단과 인터뷰에서 “과거 이명박 정부 시절 사모펀드에 대한 규제가 완화되면서 위험성이 노출됐고 그 피해가 이번에 확인된 것”이라며 이렇게 말했다. 인수 자금 회수에만 집중한 사모펀드 엠비케이의 부실 경영이 이번 사태를 초래했다고 짚은 것이다. 앞서 서울회생법원은 지난 3일 홈플러스의 회생절차 폐지를 결정했다. 14일 내에 2천억원 규모의 자금 조달 방안을 마련하지 못하면 폐지 결정은 확정된다. )

Regarding a report published by the U.S. House Judiciary Committee's Republican members claiming that "the South Korean government is discriminating against U.S. companies like Coupang," Secretary Hong criticized it as "very inappropriate because it unilaterally reflects Coupang's position." Hong said to Coupang, "If it is a U.S. company that grew based on Korean society, it is highly inappropriate to turn the company's wrongdoing into a diplomatic issue by leveraging the U.S. Congress or government, instead of resolving it from the public's perspective." ( 홍 수석은 “인수·합병이 잘못됐을 때 부작용을 가장 상징적으로 보여준 게 홈플러스 사태”라며 “특히나 대규모 실업이 발생할 여지가 있고, 협력업체의 피해가 광범위하게 있다는 측면에서 앞으로 이러한 일이 재발하지 않도록 관련 제도 개선도 금융당국이 적극적으로 모색해야 된다”고 덧붙였다. )

Shim Woo-sam, Reporter wu32@hani.co.kr ( 홍 수석은 미국 하원 법사위원회 공화당 쪽이 ‘한국 정부가 쿠팡 등 미국 기업을 차별하고 있다’고 주장하는 보고서를 발표한 것과 관련해서는 “일방적으로 쿠팡의 입장을 반영한 것이기 때문에 매우 부적절하다”고 비판했다. 홍 수석은 쿠팡을 향해 “지금 미국 기업이지만 한국 사회를 바탕으로 해서 성장한 기업이라면, 이런 식으로 기업이 잘못한 문제를 국민 눈높이에서 해소하려 하지 않고 미국 의회나 정부에 힘입어 외교적 사안으로 만드는 것은 매우 부적절하다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: “Permanent Ban on Re-Admission for Violating Party Discipline”… Ethics Committee Begins Review of Pro-Han Faction (장동혁 “해당행위자 복당 영구 금지”…윤리위는 친한계 등 심의 착수)
item.description:
People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk stated on the 6th, “For those who seriously violate party discipline, we must permanently ban re-admission, even if it requires revising the party constitution and rules.” On the same day, the party’s Central Ethics Committee held its first plenary session after the June 3 local elections and began deliberating disciplinary requests targeting pro-Han Dong-hoon faction lawmakers, signaling the start of a full-fledged “disciplinary political phase.” (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 6일 “심각한 해당 행위자에 대해선 당헌·당규를 개정해서라도 복당을 영구 금지해야 한다”고 말했다. 같은 날 당 중앙윤리위원회가 6·3 지방선거 이후 첫 전체회의를 열고 친한동훈계 의원 등을 대상으로 징계 요구안 심의에 들어가면서 ‘징계 정국’이 본격화하는 모양새다.)

During a closed-door Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly, Jang reportedly ordered a full investigation into allegations that some PPP council members in Pohang City Council, North Gyeongsang Province, colluded with the Democratic Party regarding the election of the council chair and standing committee chairs, contrary to the central party’s directives. He stated, “Violations of the party constitution and rules must be dealt with strictly and consistently under the principle of fairness.” Since Jang’s remarks came just before the Ethics Committee meeting, which was the first since the local elections, they were interpreted as a hardline statement targeting even pro-Han faction lawmakers. <<> Senior spokesperson Park Seong-hoon told reporters, “(Jang’s remarks) are a measure for the party’s continuity and align with the will of party members,” but added, “What Jang said today was about ensuring the central party holds the reins and disciplines local incidents to uphold party discipline. I’m saying this to prevent misunderstandings from growing.” He went on the defensive, implying the remarks were not aimed at party lawmakers in the National Assembly. <<> Meanwhile, the Ethics Committee held a closed-door plenary session in the afternoon to discuss disciplinary motions submitted to the committee before and after the June 3 local elections. The committee reviewed whether to discipline around 30 individuals, including pro-Han faction lawmakers who supported independent leader Han Dong-hoon during the local elections and those who criticized leader Jang, but failed to reach a final conclusion. The Ethics Committee is reportedly focusing on ensuring procedural legitimacy to prevent a repeat of past cases, such as the discipline of lawmaker Bae Hyun-jin, which was overturned by a court injunction. <<> Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon objected, saying, “It seems not just the pro-Han faction but the entire ‘anti-Jang’ faction is the target (of discipline).” A pro-Han Dong-hoon faction lawmaker mentioned as a potential disciplinary target told *The Hankyoreh*, “(Jang) is effectively shouting that re-admitting Han Dong-hoon is impossible,” while adding, “In a situation where even mentioning discipline has become laughable and a subject of mockery, discipline has become a badge of honor.” <<> The party’s internal strife is deepening. <<> Lawmaker Choi Hyeong-doo said on KBS Radio, “Disciplinary politics is destructive politics,” while lawmaker Lee Jong-bae posted on Facebook, “Discipline to establish order will only bring conflict and division.” Conversely, lawmaker Lee Jin-sook appeared on Channel A and argued, “If we let issues that need to be addressed slide, order and principles will be ignored.” <<> Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr, Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr ( 장 대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 비공개 최고위원회의에서 최근 경북 포항시의회에서 당 소속 일부 의원들이 의장·상임위원장을 두고 중앙당 방침과 달리 민주당과 야합했다는 의혹에 대해 전수조사를 지시하며 “당헌·당규 위반 행위는 원칙대로 엄정 대응해야 하고, 징계의 잣대는 일관돼야 한다”고 발언했다고 한다. 장 대표의 발언은 지방선거 뒤 이날 처음 열리는 윤리위 회의 직전에 나온 발언이라 친한계 의원까지 겨냥한 강경 발언 아니냐는 해석이 나왔다.)

item.title: Semiconductor Industrial Complex to Be Built on Site of Gwangju Air Force Base (광주 군공항 터에 반도체 산단 짓는다)
item.description:
The presidential office decided on the 6th to establish the Honam Semiconductor Industrial Complex on the site of the air force base in Gwangsan-gu, Gwangju Metropolitan City, which will be integrated with South Jeolla Province. President Lee Jae-myung emphasized a fast-track approach, stating, “Investment execution must never be delayed due to procedural red tape.” (청와대가 6일 호남 반도체 산업단지를 전남광주통합특별시 광산구 군 공항 부지에 조성하기로 결정했다. 이재명 대통령은 “행정절차 지연으로 투자 집행이 늦어져선 절대 안 된다”며 속도전을 강조했다.)

In a briefing following a ‘public-private joint inspection meeting for mega-projects’ held at the presidential office chaired by President Lee, Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik announced, “Companies have indicated that among the candidate locations in the Honam region, the Gwangju air force base is the most suitable site. We have decided to build the Honam semiconductor industrial complex on the Gwangju air force base.” Kang said, “The Gwangju air force base site can secure about 820,000 pyeong of land, and due to the nature of an airfield, the land is already leveled, which offers the advantage of minimizing construction time.” He added, “It is adjacent to the Gwangju city center and the KTX station, providing strengths in manpower acquisition and living conditions, and it has been assessed as having excellent logistics accessibility linked to roads, airports, and ports.” The site selection came just a week after President Lee announced a 896 trillion won investment in the Honam semiconductor industrial complex at the ‘National Report on Korea’s Three Major Mega Leap Projects’ on the 29th of last month. Regarding the Yongin semiconductor industrial complex, Kang also stated, “We have decided to advance the overall schedule as much as possible, from land compensation to the supply of electricity and water, to ensure that the planned investment of 10 fabs proceeds at a much faster pace.” (강훈식 대통령비서실장은 이날 이 대통령 주재로 청와대에서 열린 ‘메가프로젝트 민관합동 점검회의’ 결과 브리핑에서 “기업들은 호남권 입지 후보지 중에 광주 군 공항이 가장 적합한 부지라는 의견을 제시했다”며 “광주 군 공항 부지에 호남권 반도체 산단을 조성하기로 결정했다”고 발표했다. 강 실장은 “광주 군 공항 지역은 약 250만평 규모의 부지 확보가 가능하고, 공항 특성상 이미 ​평탄화가 완료돼 있는 만큼 공사 기간을 최소화할 수 있다는 장점이 있다”며 “광주 도심과 케이티엑스(KTX)역에 인접해 있어 인력 확보와 정주 여건 측면에서도 강점이 있으며 도로, 공항, 항만 등과 연계한 물류 접근성도 우수한 것으로 검토됐다”고 말했다. 이 대통령이 지난달 29일 ‘대한민국 대도약 3대 메가프로젝트 국민보고회’에서 호남권 반도체 산단에 896조원을 투자한다고 발표한 지 일주일 만에 부지가 결정된 것이다. 강 실장은 용인 반도체 산단에 대해서도 “계획된 팹(공장) 10기 투자가 훨씬 빠른 속도로 추진될 수 있도록 토지 보상부터 전력, 용수 공급까지 전반적인 일정을 최대한 앞당기기로 했다”고 말했다.)

President Lee promised swift investment support, saying, “The government will do its utmost.” In his opening remarks, President Lee said, “Speed is everything,” and emphasized, “The central government must anticipate all potential obstacles and proactively resolve them so that companies can focus solely on working at the investment sites.” President Lee proposed measures including simplifying environmental impact assessments, reducing time through parallel pursuit of negotiated acquisition and compulsory expropriation during land acquisition, and preemptively expanding infrastructure for electricity and water. (이 대통령은 “정부가 할 수 있는 최대치를 하겠다”며 신속한 투자 지원을 약속했다. 이 대통령은 머리발언에서 “오직 속도전이 중요하다”며 “중앙정부는 기업들이 오로지 투자 현장에서 일하는 데만 집중할 수 있도록 예상되는 걸림돌 모두 예측하고 선제적으로 해결해나가야 한다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 △환경영향평가 간소화 △토지취득 과정에서 협의 취득과 강제수용 병행 추진을 통한 시간 단축 △전력, 용수 기반 시설 선제 확충 등을 제시했다.)

The presidential office announced that the public-private joint inspection meeting for mega-projects chaired by President Lee will be held monthly, and a dedicated organization will be established to monitor implementation progress. (청와대는 이 대통령이 주재하는 메가프로젝트 관련 민관합동 점검회의를 매달 한차례 열고, 전담기구를 신설해 이행 상황을 점검하도록 하겠다고 발표했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lee Byung-tae resigns over 'May 18' controversial remarks (‘5·18 망언’ 이병태 사퇴)
item.description:
Lee Byung-tae, deputy chairman of the Presidential Regulatory Reform Committee, who sparked controversy with his remarks about 'May 18 being sanctified,' resigned on the 6th. (‘5·18 성역화’ 발언으로 논란을 일으킨 이병태 대통령 직속 규제합리화위원회 부위원장이 6일 사퇴했다.)

Cheong Wa Dae spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung said that day, "Deputy Chairman Lee Byung-tae has expressed his intention to resign," adding, "We inform you that Cheong Wa Dae has decided to accept this." Deputy Chairman Lee also posted a statement on Facebook, saying, "I have decided to step down from the deputy chairmanship after much deliberation, based on the judgment that I should not burden the appointing authority and the government, and following a recommendation for voluntary resignation. It was my fault for not properly considering political sensitivity." (강유정 청와대 대변인은 이날 “이병태 부위원장이 사퇴 의사를 전했다”며 “청와대는 이를 수용하기로 했음을 알린다”고 밝혔다. 이 부위원장도 페이스북에 입장문을 올려 “임명권자와 정부에 부담을 주어서는 안 된다는 판단과 자진 사퇴 권고에 따라, 고심 끝에 부위원장직을 내려놓기로 결정했다”며 “정치적 민감성을 제대로 살피지 못한 제 불찰”이라고 했다.)

Deputy Chairman Lee sparked controversy on the 2nd when he posted on Facebook regarding the severe disciplinary action taken against students from the Baejae High School baseball team for 'May 18 hate cheering,' claiming that "May 18 has become a sanctuary in this land" and that it was "a scene from North Korea." Although Cheong Wa Dae issued a stern warning on the 4th, calling it "inappropriate behavior," and requested no recurrence, Deputy Chairman Lee reiterated his stance on Facebook on the 5th and 6th, stating, "The core of my opinion is freedom of expression." This led to demands from the ruling party for his voluntary resignation, and on the 6th, Cheong Wa Dae stated, "Because the matter is very serious, we recommended Deputy Chairman Lee's resignation." (이 부위원장은 지난 2일 페이스북에 ‘5·18 혐오 응원’으로 배재고 야구부 학생들이 중징계 처분을 받은 것과 관련해 “이 땅에 5·18이 성역이 된 것”, “북한의 모습”이라고 주장해 논란을 빚었다. 청와대가 4일 “부적절한 처신”이라며 엄중 경고하고 재발 방지를 요청했지만, 이 부위원장은 5일과 6일에도 페이스북에 “내 의견의 핵심은 표현의 자유”라며 자신의 주장을 고수하는 글을 재차 올렸다. 이에 여권에서 이 부위원장이 자진 사퇴해야 한다는 요구가 터져 나왔고, 청와대는 6일 “사안이 매우 엄중한 까닭에 이 부위원장의 사퇴를 권고했다”고 밝혔다.)

Deputy Chairman Lee, a professor emeritus at the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), is a conservative figure who served as the head of the policy general headquarters for candidate Hong Jun-pyo's camp during the People Power Party's presidential primary last year. He was appointed as deputy chairman of the Regulatory Reform Committee, a ministerial-level position, in March under President Lee Jae-myung's policy of integration and pragmatism. Even at the time of his appointment, he had stirred controversy over past remarks, such as saying "pro-Japanese acts are natural and normal" and describing the Sewol ferry disaster memorial event as "a symbol of this society's shallowness." (한국과학기술원(KAIST) 명예교수인 이 부위원장은 지난해 국민의힘 대선 경선 당시 홍준표 후보 캠프 정책총괄본부장을 맡은 보수 출신 인사다. 이재명 대통령의 통합·실용 인사 기조에 따라 지난 3월 총리급인 규제합리화위 부위원장에 임명됐다. 임명 당시에도 “친일은 당연한 것이고 정상적인 것”이라고 말하거나 세월호 참사 추모 행사를 “이 사회의 천박함의 상징”이라고 표현한 과거 발언으로 막말 논란에 휩싸인 바 있다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "National Fate Decided by Competition, Who's Faster"... Environmental Groups Express 'Concerns' (이 대통령 “국운 건 경쟁, 누가 빠르냐로 결판”…환경단체는 ‘우려’)
item.description:
At the public-private joint review meeting for megaprojects held on the 6th, when the site for the Honam semiconductor industrial complex was confirmed as the Gwangju Air Force base location, President Lee Jae-myung consistently emphasized speed and full government support. In contrast, environmental groups expressed concerns over potential side effects from streamlining the environmental impact assessment process. <<>> At the meeting held at the presidential office, President Lee stated, "In a situation of all-out competition where national fate is at stake, it seems the outcome is decided by who can preempt it faster, who is quicker." He added, "There must absolutely be no delays in investment execution due to administrative procedure slowdowns." The presidential office aims to complete the Honam semiconductor industrial complex within President Lee's term. (호남 반도체 산업단지 입지를 광주 군 공항 부지로 결정한 6일 메가프로젝트 민관합동 점검회의에서 내내 이재명 대통령이 강조한 것은 속도와 정부의 전폭적인 지원이었다. 반면 환경단체들은 환경영향평가 간소화 과정 등에서 발생할 수 있는 부작용을 우려하고 나섰다.)

Referring to the environmental impact assessment, President Lee said, "If it's the same area, is there really a need to do it again? If there's already one, it's important to apply the results, and even if a new assessment is conducted, the timeframe needs to be significantly shortened." He noted that in the land acquisition process, going through negotiated acquisition followed by compulsory expropriation takes considerable time, and said, "I hope all procedures can be carried out concurrently or in parallel as long as they are not illegal." (이 대통령은 청와대에서 열린 회의에서 “국운이 걸린 총력경쟁이 벌어지고 있는 상황에서는 누가 얼마나 더 빨리 선점하느냐, 누가 더 빠르냐로 결판이 나는 거 같다”며 “행정절차 지연으로 투자 집행이 늦어지는 일이 절대로 있어선 안 된다”고 말했다. 청와대는 이 대통령 임기 안에 호남 반도체 산단 완공을 목표로 한다.)

President Lee also emphasized preemptive government support. He stated, "Since there is a significant amount of excess tax revenue in the semiconductor industry, we will provide all support, including financial support." After the meeting, Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik said, "The Future Response Fund, funded by the semiconductor industry boom, will be positively considered for use in building the semiconductor complex." (이 대통령은 환경영향평가를 언급하며 “같은 지역인데 굳이 또다시 할 필요가 있느냐. 이미 있다면 결과를 원용하는 게 중요하겠고, 새로 실시하더라도 기간을 대폭 단축할 필요가 있겠다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 토지 취득 과정에서 협의취득 뒤 강제수용 절차를 밟는 게 시간이 많이 걸린다며 “모든 절차를 불법이 아닌 한 동행, 병행 추진하도록 했으면 좋겠다”고 말했다.)

President Lee also told companies, "I hope you speak directly," adding, "Relevant ministries must clearly present their timelines. Vague approaches are absolutely unacceptable." Regarding the conservative opposition, he said, "I hope you either criticize based on the premise that the megaproject is impossible, or point out imbalances based on the premise that it is possible—just pick one." (이 대통령은 선제적인 정부 지원도 강조했다. 이 대통령은 “반도체 산업 분야의 초과 세수가 많이 발생하기 때문에 재정 지원을 포함한 모든 지원을 하겠다”고 말했다. 회의 뒤 강훈식 대통령비서실장은 “반도체 산업 호황에 따라 마련되는 미래대응기금이 반도체 산단을 만드는 데 쓰일지 긍정적으로 검토될 것”이라고 말했다.)

After the meeting, Chief Kang stated, "It was decided to hold a president-chaired public-private joint review meeting every month," adding, "Since the president said he will set up a dedicated office at the presidential palace and personally oversee it, we have agreed to appoint a heavyweight figure to manage the overall progress of megaprojects by task and coordinate differences between ministries." (이 대통령은 기업들에도 “직설적으로 하셨으면 좋겠다”며 “관련 부처도 추진 일정을 명확하게 제시해야 한다. 두루뭉술은 절대 안 된다”고 말했다. 보수 야권을 향해서는 “(메가프로젝트가) 불가능하다는 것을 전제로 비난을 하든지, 가능하다는 전제로 불균형을 지적하든지 둘 중 하나만 하면 좋겠다”고 했다.)

Environmental groups reacted against President Lee's 'speed drive.' Green Korea United pointed out, "The environmental impact assessment is not an obstacle that slows down projects, but a minimum safety device to stop improper development. Before supporting corporate investments, the government should first present principles for public interest in electricity, water, and land use, the cumulative impact on local environments, and land use principles in the era of climate crisis." The Korean Federation for Environmental Movements also criticized, "The president is directly denying the purpose and role of the environmental impact assessment system." (강 실장은 회의 뒤 “대통령 주재 민관합동 점검회의를 매달 개최하기로 했다”며 “대통령이 청와대에 전담 기구를 두고 직접 챙기겠다고 하신 만큼 중량감 있는 인사를 임명해 메가프로젝트 전반에 대한 과제별 진도 점검과 부처 간 이견 조정 등을 총괄하게 한다는 데 의견을 모았다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Reporter Jang Su-kyung flying710@hani.co.kr (환경단체들은 이 대통령의 ‘속도전’에 반발했다. 녹색연합은 “환경영향평가는 사업 속도를 늦추는 장애물이 아니라 잘못된 개발을 멈출 수 있는 최소한의 안전장치”라며 “정부는 기업 투자 지원에 앞서 전력·용수·토지 이용의 공공성, 지역 환경에 미치는 누적 영향, 기후위기 시대의 국토 이용 원칙을 먼저 제시해야 한다”고 지적했다. 환경운동연합도 “대통령이 직접 환경영향평가 제도의 취지와 역할을 부정하고 있다”고 비판했다.)
